facts.fact: NOSi's release says NOSi is the manager of the State's Private Technology Network (RTPE) and presented a unified VoIP platform for RTPE users, which it designed and developed.
NOSi says it designed and developed the VKonekta VoIP platform for RTPE users, which was publicly presented in Praia on 14 August 2024.

CPV.note: Whether VKonekta was already in use at the presentation is not stated beyond the public presentation.
